title: DEMO-1 · The case of the slow page
headline: The case of the slow page

lines.say: Whiskers! Our product page takes four seconds to load. Customers are leaving!
lines.show: Whiskers! Our product page takes 4 seconds to load. Customers are leaving!

lines.say: Four seconds, you say? Let's look at the evidence.
Every visit asks the database for the same price list. Again, and again, and again.
So we keep asking a question we already know the answer to?
Exactly. Keep the answer in a cache for a minute, and the page loads in a blink.
